modifier_object.mapping_evidence: The debug ELF contains exactly 52 contiguous developer strings from file offsets 0x4F9E70 through 0x4FA3D4, followed immediately by the six ai/mods/p%d category path strings. 0x00093C5C initializes exactly 0x34 (52) integer slots in the 0xD4-byte object, and 0x00091E04/0x00091E58 index those slots as 4-byte integers. Combat call sites use indices whose developer labels match the surrounding arithmetic.

overhaul_relevance: The retail overhaul no longer needs to invent a stamina/damage architecture from UI names: the debug build exposes concrete energy drain/regeneration, max-energy degradation/recovery, health regeneration/max-health degradation, punch-damage, flash-KO and KO-moment functions.
These are debug-build addresses. Before patching, each target must be matched to ULUS10066 by instruction/data-flow signature and its original bytes/ABI verified.
0x0007EB7C is currently the strongest damage hook candidate; 0x00079E80 and 0x00079DF4 are the strongest stamina/energy hook candidates.
